title: Verify positive main flow for Admin User Authentication & Role-Based Access
preconditions: The user possesses a valid administrator account in OrangeHRM.
The user navigates to the OrangeHRM login page using a supported web browser.

testSteps.action: Enter a valid administrator username in the Username field.
testSteps.expectedResult: Username field contains the entered value.

testSteps.action: Enter the corresponding password in the Password field.
testSteps.expectedResult: Password field contains the entered value (masked).
User is redirected to the Dashboard page with a personalized greeting.

expectedResults: User is redirected to the Dashboard page with a personalized greeting.

title: Verify exception handling: Empty Fields Validation
preconditions: The user possesses a valid administrator account in OrangeHRM.
The user navigates to the OrangeHRM login page using a supported web browser.

testSteps.action: Set up scenario where Username or Password field is left empty and the Login button is pressed.

testSteps.expectedResult: Display inline validation message "Required" next to each empty field and keep the user on the login page.

expectedResults: Display inline validation message "Required" next to each empty field and keep the user on the login page.

title: Verify exception handling: Invalid Credentials
preconditions: The user possesses a valid administrator account in OrangeHRM.
The user navigates to the OrangeHRM login page using a supported web browser.

testSteps.action: Set up scenario where Entered username and/or password do not match an active administrator account.

testSteps.expectedResult: Display an inline error message "Invalid credentials" above the login form and remain on the login page.

expectedResults: Display an inline error message "Invalid credentials" above the login form and remain on the login page.

title: Verify alternate flow: Forgot Password Flow
preconditions: The user possesses a valid administrator account in OrangeHRM.
The user navigates to the OrangeHRM login page using a supported web browser.

testSteps.action: User clicks the "Forgot your password?" link located beneath the login form.
System navigates to the Password Reset Request screen.
User follows the password reset process as defined in the password recovery module.

expectedResults: Alternate pathway Forgot Password Flow completes successfully

title: Verify data validation rules for Admin User Authentication & Role-Based Access
preconditions: The user possesses a valid administrator account in OrangeHRM.
The user navigates to the OrangeHRM login page using a supported web browser.

testSteps.action: Attempt input violating rules for: Username (Required; maximum length 50 characters; must match an existing admin account identifier.), Password (Required; minimum length 8 characters; must be stored and compared using secure hashing (e.g., bcrypt).)

Provide compliant inputs for: Username (Required; maximum length 50 characters; must match an existing admin account identifier.), Password (Required; minimum length 8 characters; must be stored and compared using secure hashing (e.g., bcrypt).)

expectedResults: System enforces input data requirements correctly
